card.architecture: Rectified-flow DiT (T5-XXL + CLIP-L), LADD-distilled 1-4 step, whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through FLUX.1-schnell using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn in FLUX's style at 4 steps. The fast, Apache-licensed member of the family — lower peak fidelity than dev, but a few-step redraw.
card.pick_when: You want a FAST whole-image redraw and can accept slightly lower fidelity than FLUX.1-dev.

prompt.guidance: Describe the finished picture in a sentence or two. Lower the redraw strength to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let schnell reinterpret more.
prompt.example: A vibrant Bangkok street-food market at night, neon signs reflecting on wet pavement, steam rising from stalls, crowds, cinematic, highly detailed
prompt.instructions:
Type the FULL description of the picture you want — this is a whole-frame re-render, not an edit instruction, and FLUX.1-schnell follows natural-language prose.
4 steps, euler/simple, CFG 1 — LADD-distilled, so there is no guidance knob.
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.3-0.5 keeps the source's structure and mostly restyles it, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it.
The source is normalized to the configured ~1 MP working budget with its aspect ratio preserved, so low-resolution inputs gain a larger VAE grid and oversized inputs are reduced before sampling.
Negative prompts are inactive: the model runs at CFG 1.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a description; the whole frame is redrawn through FLUX.1-schnell in 4 steps. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: a fast whole-image redraw keeping the composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: fast 4-step redraw of an entire image through FLUX.1-schnell, keeping composition
